secondarysystem/sec-trivia/text:
Nintendo Entertainment System is the third generation home video game console.
First released in Japan in July 1983 and discontinued in 2003.
Made by Nintendo.
It launched at $199.99 in the US.
About 61.9 million units were sold.
Its library has 1,370 games.
It followed the Color TV-Game and was succeeded by the Super Nintendo Entertainment System.
Processors include the Ricoh 2A03.
